idea-plugin.name: SearchDeadCode
idea-plugin.description:
Finds dead Kotlin and Java code in Android projects and helps you delete it safely.

The plugin drives the searchdeadcode command-line analyzer. Run a scan from the Tools menu, review the findings in the editor (dead declarations are greyed out, with the detector id and a link to its documentation) and in the SearchDeadCode tool window, then act on each one:

  • Delete the declaration when the analyzer provides a safe whole-line fix
  • Ignore it in place with a mandatory reason (// deadcode:ignore(...))
  • Add it to the team baseline (.deadcode-baseline.json, the same file the CLI's CI profile picks up)

The analyzer binary is not bundled. The plugin looks for it on PATH (Homebrew, cargo, scoop and winget installs are found automatically) or offers to download the release matching the plugin version from GitHub, verified against its published SHA-256 checksum. Findings always come from the files on disk: the plugin saves your open documents before scanning and drops a file's findings the moment you edit it, so a stale line number can never delete the wrong code.

action.description: Run the searchdeadcode analyzer on the whole project
